text_block_list.text:
The day of the Asahi Hai Futurity 
Stakes—the race to decide the Junior tier 
champion—has finally arrived—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to GⅠ races after all, the 
atmosphere at the racetrack really is 
quite different~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: And how I feel when I run, too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, no, no. I just can't wait for it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I put in plenty of training, too, so I'm 
in the most purr-fect shape ever, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I just know we can put on the best race 
ever! I'm so itching to run!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm going full throttle right from 
the start!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa... Looking at the GⅠ paddock from 
this side is so breathtaking...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'll have to put on a race that'll 
blow everyone away!

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky-san, I look forward to working 
with you today!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's a pleasure on my end too!

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
As someone hailed as the "Supercar," I 
knew you would definitely make it to this 
grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I've trained to the absolute 
limit, more than ever before."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! Fufu... I'll run with all my might 
too, so let's make it a fun race!

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's both do our best!

text_block_list.name: PA Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"The paddock for today's main race runners 
is about to begin!"
